package smb

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/authz"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

func gateQfidDecode(t *testing.T, data []byte) []wire.CreateContext {
	t.Helper()
	var result []wire.CreateContext
	for len(data) > 0 {
		if len(data) < 24 || len(data)%8 != 0 || smbLE.Uint16(data[4:]) != 16 || smbLE.Uint16(data[6:]) != 4 || smbLE.Uint16(data[10:]) != 24 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid context header %x", data)
		}
		next := int(smbLE.Uint32(data))
		end := len(data)
		if next != 0 {
			if next < 24 || next%8 != 0 || next >= len(data) {
				t.Fatalf("invalid next %d", next)
			}
			end = next
		}
		size := int(smbLE.Uint32(data[12:]))
		if size > end-24 || (24+size+7)&^7 != end {
			t.Fatalf("invalid context payload %d/%d", size, end)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(data[20:24], make([]byte, 4)) || !bytes.Equal(data[24+size:end], make([]byte, end-24-size)) {
			t.Fatal("nonzero context padding")
		}
		result = append(result, wire.CreateContext{Name: bytes.Clone(data[16:20]), Data: bytes.Clone(data[24 : 24+size])})
		if next == 0 {
			break
		}
		data = data[next:]
	}
	return result
}
func gateQfidIdentity(t *testing.T, body []byte) (uint64, uint64, wire.FileID) {
	t.Helper()
	if len(body) != 144 || smbLE.Uint16(body) != 89 || body[2] != 0 || smbLE.Uint32(body[80:]) != 152 || smbLE.Uint32(body[84:]) != 56 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid NONE/QFid CREATE %x", body)
	}
	contexts := gateQfidDecode(t, body[88:])
	if len(contexts) != 1 || string(contexts[0].Name) != "QFid" || len(contexts[0].Data) != 32 || !bytes.Equal(contexts[0].Data[16:], make([]byte, 16)) {
		t.Fatalf("invalid truthful identity context %+v", contexts)
	}
	var id wire.FileID
	copy(id[:], body[64:80])
	return smbLE.Uint64(contexts[0].Data), smbLE.Uint64(contexts[0].Data[8:]), id
}
func TestGateAlwaysQFidContexts(t *testing.T) {
	attr := windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 83}}}
	for _, name := range []string{"absent", "requested-first", "requested-middle", "requested-last"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			items := []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("MxAc")}, {Name: []byte("RqLs")}, {Name: []byte("DH2Q")}}
			at := map[string]int{"requested-first": 0, "requested-middle": 1, "requested-last": 3}[name]
			if name != "absent" {
				items = append(items, wire.CreateContext{})
				copy(items[at+1:], items[at:])
				items[at] = wire.CreateContext{Name: []byte("QFid")}
			}
			request := wire.CreateRequest{Contexts: items}
			before := make([]wire.CreateContext, len(items))
			for i, v := range items {
				before[i] = wire.CreateContext{Name: bytes.Clone(v.Name), Data: bytes.Clone(v.Data)}
			}
			ctx := context.WithValue(t.Context(), maximalAccessKey{}, func(windowsAttr) (uint32, error) { return 0x81, nil })
			encoded, err := createContexts(ctx, request, attr, 0x123456789, nil)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(request.Contexts, before) {
				t.Fatal("request contexts mutated")
			}
			got := gateQfidDecode(t, encoded)
			want := []string{"MxAc", "QFid"}
			if name == "requested-first" {
				want = []string{"QFid", "MxAc"}
			}
			if len(got) != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("contexts=%+v", got)
			}
			for i, item := range got {
				if string(item.Name) != want[i] {
					t.Fatalf("context order %+v", got)
				}
				if string(item.Name) == "QFid" {
					if len(item.Data) != 32 || smbLE.Uint64(item.Data) != 83 || smbLE.Uint64(item.Data[8:]) != 0x123456789 || !bytes.Equal(item.Data[16:], make([]byte, 16)) {
						t.Fatalf("identity %x", item.Data)
					}
				} else if !bytes.Equal(item.Data, []byte{0, 0, 0, 0, 0x81, 0, 0, 0}) {
					t.Fatalf("MxAc changed %x", item.Data)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	for _, items := range [][]wire.CreateContext{{{Name: []byte("QFid")}, {Name: []byte("QFid")}}, {{Name: []byte("QFid"), Data: []byte{1}}}} {
		if body, err := createContexts(t.Context(), wire.CreateRequest{Contexts: items}, attr, 1, nil); !errors.Is(err, syscall.EINVAL) || body != nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid identity request encoded", err)
		}
	}
	for _, count := range []int{1017, 1018} {
		items := make([]wire.CreateContext, count)
		for i := range items {
			items[i] = wire.CreateContext{Name: []byte("MxAc")}
		}
		body, err := createContexts(t.Context(), wire.CreateRequest{Contexts: items}, attr, 1, nil)
		if count == 1017 {
			if err != nil || len(body) != count*32+56 {
				t.Fatalf("exact bound %d %v", len(body), err)
			}
		} else if !errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOMEM) || body != nil {
			t.Fatalf("overflow accepted %d %v", len(body), err)
		}
	}
}

type gateQfidBackend struct {
	windowsBackend
	state windowsState
	err   error
	calls int
}

func (b *gateQfidBackend) State(context.Context) (windowsState, error) {
	b.calls++
	return b.state, b.err
}
func gateQfidDispatcher() (*fileDispatcher, *commandFile, *commandSession, *gateQfidBackend) {
	d, file, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
	d.handles = make(map[wire.FileID]*fileHandle)
	backend := &gateQfidBackend{state: windowsState{VolumeIdentity: "actual-volume", VolumeSerial: 0x123456789}}
	d.backend = backend
	return d, file, session, backend
}
func TestGateAlwaysQFidAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"absent", "requested", "duplicate", "nonempty", "durable-reconnect", "durable-v2-reconnect", "unknown-context", "malformed", "invalid-access", "invalid-options", "state-error", "state-outage", "unknown-volume", "known-zero", "malformed-maximal", "capacity"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, file, session, backend := gateQfidDispatcher()
			opens := 0
			session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				opens++
				return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr}, nil
			}
			request := createCommand("", 1, 1)
			want := uint32(fileSuccess)
			wantState := 1
			switch name {
			case "requested":
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("QFid")}})
			case "duplicate":
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("QFid")}, {Name: []byte("QFid")}})
				want = fileInvalidParameter
				wantState = 0
			case "nonempty":
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("QFid"), Data: []byte{1}}})
				want = fileInvalidParameter
				wantState = 0
			case "durable-reconnect", "durable-v2-reconnect", "unknown-context":
				contextName := map[string]string{"durable-reconnect": "DHnC", "durable-v2-reconnect": "DH2C", "unknown-context": "What"}[name]
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte(contextName)}})
				want = fileNotSupported
				wantState = 0
			case "malformed":
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("QFid")}})
				smbLE.PutUint32(request.Body[48:], 0xffffff00)
				want = fileInvalidParameter
				wantState = 0
			case "invalid-access":
				smbLE.PutUint32(request.Body[24:], 0x400)
				want = fileNotSupported
				wantState = 0
			case "invalid-options":
				smbLE.PutUint32(request.Body[40:], 8)
				want = fileNotSupported
				wantState = 0
			case "state-error":
				backend.err = syscall.EACCES
				want = statusDenied
			case "state-outage":
				backend.err = syscall.EIO
				want = fileIOError
			case "malformed-maximal":
				request = requestContexts(t, request, []wire.CreateContext{{Name: []byte("MxAc"), Data: []byte{1}}})
				want, wantState = fileInvalidParameter, 0
			case "capacity":
				d.limits.MaxOpens = 0
				want = fileInsufficientResources
			case "unknown-volume":
				backend.state.VolumeIdentity = ""
				want = fileIOError
			case "known-zero":
				backend.state.VolumeSerial = 0
			}
			before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
			body, status := d.create(t.Context(), request)
			if status != want || backend.calls != wantState {
				t.Fatalf("status=%x want=%x State=%d want=%d", status, want, backend.calls, wantState)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
				t.Fatal("borrowed CREATE request mutated")
			}
			if status == 0 {
				node, volume, _ := gateQfidIdentity(t, body)
				if node != file.attr.ID || volume != backend.state.VolumeSerial || opens != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("identity=%d/%d opens=%d", node, volume, opens)
				}
			} else if body != nil || opens != 0 || len(d.handles) != 0 || session.closed != 0 {
				t.Fatal("failed admission opened or invented identity", opens, session.closed)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGateAlwaysQFidCapturedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	d, file, session, backend := gateQfidDispatcher()
	opens := 0
	current := file
	session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
		opens++
		return windowsOpenResult{File: current, Attr: current.attr}, nil
	}
	var ids []wire.FileID
	for _, node := range []uint64{7, 7, 19} {
		if node != current.attr.ID {
			current = &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: node, Kind: storage.NodeRegular}}}}
		}
		body, status := d.create(t.Context(), createCommand("", 1, 1))
		if status != 0 {
			t.Fatal(status)
		}
		got, volume, id := gateQfidIdentity(t, body)
		if got != node || volume != backend.state.VolumeSerial {
			t.Fatal(got, volume)
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
		// A mutable stat result cannot redefine the identity captured by this open.
		current.attr.ID = node + 1000
		reply, status := d.queryInfo(t.Context(), queryCommand(id, 1, 6, 8))
		if status != 0 || len(reply) != 16 || smbLE.Uint64(reply[8:]) != got {
			t.Fatalf("QFid/QI6 mismatch %x %x", status, reply)
		}
		current.attr.ID = node
	}
	if opens != 3 || backend.calls != 3 || ids[0] == ids[1] || ids[1] == ids[2] {
		t.Fatal("extra opens, state lookups or recycled wire handles", opens, backend.calls)
	}
}

type gateQfidCloseFailure struct {
	windowsSession
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (s *gateQfidCloseFailure) Close(context.Context) error { s.calls++; return s.err }
func TestGateAlwaysQFidFailureOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"denied", "unknown", "missing-file", "zero-node", "frame-bound", "encoding-bound", "cleanup-error"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, file, session, backend := gateQfidDispatcher()
			opens := 0
			session.open = func(windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				opens++
				switch name {
				case "denied":
					return windowsOpenResult{}, syscall.EACCES
				case "unknown":
					return windowsOpenResult{}, syscall.EIO
				case "missing-file":
					return windowsOpenResult{Attr: file.attr}, nil
				case "zero-node":
					return windowsOpenResult{File: file}, nil
				default:
					return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr}, nil
				}
			}
			request := createCommand("", 1, 1)
			var cleanup *gateQfidCloseFailure
			if name == "frame-bound" || name == "cleanup-error" {
				d.limits.MaxFrameBytes = 207
			}
			if name == "cleanup-error" {
				cleanup = &gateQfidCloseFailure{windowsSession: session, err: syscall.EIO}
				d.session = cleanup
			}
			if name == "encoding-bound" {
				contexts := make([]wire.CreateContext, 1018)
				for i := range contexts {
					contexts[i] = wire.CreateContext{Name: []byte("MxAc")}
				}
				request = requestContexts(t, request, contexts)
				parsed, err := wire.ParseFrame(request.Packet, wire.Limits{MaxBytes: 1 << 20, MaxCommands: 1, MaxContexts: 2000})
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				request = parsed[0]
			}
			before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
			body, status := d.create(t.Context(), request)
			want := uint32(fileIOError)
			if name == "denied" {
				want = statusDenied
			}
			if status != want || body != nil || opens != 1 || backend.calls != 1 || !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
				t.Fatalf("status=%x body=%x opens=%d states=%d", status, body, opens, backend.calls)
			}
			if name == "denied" {
				if d.fenced || session.closed != 0 {
					t.Fatal("known denial fenced session")
				}
			} else if !d.fenced || !d.failed {
				t.Fatal("uncertain/admitted failure did not fence")
			}
			if name == "cleanup-error" {
				if cleanup.calls != 1 || !errors.Is(d.cleanupErr, syscall.EIO) {
					t.Fatal("cleanup error swallowed", cleanup.calls, d.cleanupErr)
				}
			} else if name != "denied" && session.closed != 1 {
				t.Fatal("failed owner not closed", session.closed)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGateAlwaysQFidSignedNoLeasing(t *testing.T) {
	file := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 7, Kind: storage.NodeRegular, Size: 3}}}, data: []byte("abc")}
	var denied atomic.Bool
	var opens atomic.Int32
	policy := authz.AuthorizerFunc(func(ctx context.Context, r authz.AccessRequest) error {
		p, ok := PrincipalFromContext(ctx)
		if !ok || p.SID != "S-1-5-21-1" || r.Volume != "trusted" {
			return errors.New("wrong principal/volume")
		}
		if denied.Load() {
			return authz.ErrDenied
		}
		return nil
	})
	peer, _ := gateNoLeaseConnectWithAuthorizer(t, func(r windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
		opens.Add(1)
		if r.Lookup.Name == "" {
			root := &commandFile{attr: windowsAttr{windowsBasicAttr: windowsBasicAttr{Attr: storage.Attr{ID: 1, Kind: storage.NodeDirectory}}}}
			return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
		}
		if r.Lookup.ExpectedID != 0 {
			t.Error("lease preflight still active")
		}
		return windowsOpenResult{File: file, Attr: file.attr}, nil
	}, policy)
	request := gateNoLeaseRequest(t, "file", wire.OplockLease, gateNoLeaseContext(t, wire.LeaseVersion2))
	before := bytes.Clone(request.Packet)
	reply := peer.call(t, request)
	header, err := wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if err != nil || header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header, err)
	}
	node, volume, id := gateQfidIdentity(t, reply[64:])
	if node != 7 || volume != 0x123456789 || opens.Load() != 2 || !bytes.Equal(request.Packet, before) {
		t.Fatal("false identity, extra admission or mutation", node, volume, opens.Load())
	}
	denied.Store(true)
	reply = peer.call(t, readCommand(id, 0, 1))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusDenied {
		t.Fatal("authorization lost", header)
	}
	denied.Store(false)
	originalTree := peer.tree
	peer.tree = 999
	reply = peer.call(t, request)
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusNetworkDeleted || opens.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatal("unknown tree reached CREATE admission", header, opens.Load())
	}
	peer.tree = originalTree
	ack := make([]byte, 36)
	smbLE.PutUint16(ack, 36)
	reply = peer.call(t, fileRequest(wire.OplockBreak, ack))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusUnsupported {
		t.Fatal("lease ACK accepted", header)
	}
	unsigned := readCommand(id, 0, 1)
	packet := requestPacket(wire.Header{Command: wire.Read, MessageID: peer.next, SessionID: peer.sid, TreeID: peer.tree, Credits: 1}, unsigned.Body)
	peer.next++
	sendFrame(t, peer.network, packet)
	reply = readFrame(t, peer.network)
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != statusDenied {
		t.Fatal("unsigned request accepted", header)
	}
	reply = peer.call(t, gateNoLeaseClose(id))
	header, _ = wire.ParseHeader(reply)
	if header.Status != 0 {
		t.Fatal(header)
	}
	if peer.server.Status().LeaseSlots != 0 || peer.server.Status().LeaseBytes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("leasing resources allocated")
	}
}
